crossRefs.note: “Ephraim, what shall I do to you? Judah, what shall I do to you? For your love is like a morning cloud, and like the…
The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of…
who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”
The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters: but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be…
Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth. You will thresh the mountains, and beat them…
You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the whirlwind will scatter them. You will rejoice in…
Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold were broken in pieces together, and became like the chaff…

translations.web: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, and like the dew that passes away early, like the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the threshing floor, and like the smoke out of the chimney.
translations.bsb: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the early dew that vanishes, like chaff blown from a threshing floor, like smoke through an open window.
translations.kjv: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.
translations.asv: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the dew that passeth early away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the threshing-floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.
